description: Business search input for keywords, Enter search and single-result backfill.

events.description: Emitted when the value is cleared, including the clear reason.
events.name: clear

events.description: Emitted when external code should open a selection dialog.
events.name: openDialog

events.description: Emitted when a single Enter-search result is committed.
events.name: selection-commit

events.description: Requests external synchronization of the displayed label.
events.name: update:label

events.description: Requests external synchronization of the real bound value.
events.name: update:modelValue

exposes.description: Clear the current value and display label.
exposes.name: clear

props.description: Whether to show the clear button.
props.name: clearable

props.description: Whether to clear unconfirmed input on blur.
props.name: clearOnBlurUnconfirmed

props.description: Query function called when pressing Enter.
props.name: fetchApi

props.description: Whether to show the error state.
props.name: isError

props.description: Whether to render for a table-cell scenario.
props.name: isTable

props.description: Business label displayed inside the input.
props.name: label

props.description: Maps external query results into the value and label required by the component.
props.name: mapResult

props.description: Real bound value, usually a unique business identifier.
props.name: modelValue

props.description: Placeholder shown when the input is empty.
props.name: placeholder
